Further to diary 1, enquiries by J.D.C. Sugimoto
at the Headquarters, Japanese Military Police, 94,

1.

ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY POLICE.

At 12.15 p.m. 14/1/38 Sergt. Hikiji, Japanese
Military Police, Kung Dah Mill, came to Bubbling
Well Station and requested assistance to arrest a
male Chinese on Hart Road for being concerned in recent
cases of bomb throwing.

Questioned, Sergt. Hikiji stated that during the
evening of 13/1/38 they had made six arrests in Louza
District (recorded under Louza Misc. 51/38) and from
one of the arrested persons had received information
re the man on Hart Road.

The wanted man is alleged to have carried a bomb
concealed inside his trousers during January 1st & 2nd.
and to have visited various places, but for some
unknown reason did not throw same and returned with the
bomb.

Mr. E.C.Baker, D.O."B" was informed and instructed
that the necessary assistance be given.

Assistance was rendered by D.I. Toon, S.I.
Yamaguchi and J.D.C.Sugimoto.

On arrival at Hart Road, the man in custody named
Mao Kyung Kau ( 毛 金 高 ) with an escort called at
the Lee Yue Shing Washing Co ( 李 餘 興 ) 43, Hart Rd
where he called out to a male Chinese who came out on to
the road, this man was taken into custody and his
particulars are as follows.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 15 JAN 1938）

（批：DCSB 15/1）

Para 1.

协助日本军警。

1938年1月14日下午12时15分，日本军警喜吉中士来自公大纱厂，抵达静安寺巡捕房，请求协助在哈特路逮捕一名涉嫌参与近期投掷炸弹案件的华籍男子。

经询问，喜吉中士称，他们在1938年1月13日晚在老闸区实施了六起逮捕行动（记录在老闸杂项51/38号案中），并从其中一名被捕者处获得了关于哈特路那名男子的线索。

据称，该通缉犯在1月1日和2日期间，将一枚炸弹藏在裤子里携带，并走访了多处地点，但出于某种未知原因并未投掷，而是带着炸弹返回。

已告知“B”分区巡官贝克先生，并指示提供必要协助。

督察员图恩、印籍巡官山口及日籍警员杉本提供了协助。

抵达哈特路后，被押解的男子毛金高及其随行人员来到哈特路43号李余兴洗衣公司，他朝外喊话，一名华籍男子走到路上，该男子随即被拘捕，其具体情况如下。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别支部 1938年1月15日）

（批：特别支部副巡官 1月15日）

That he be returned to the S.M.P. after investi-

方家洲（〔此处转录不清〕），又名方阿厚（〔此处转录不清〕），28岁，宁波人，住哈特路43号。

经讯问，上述具名者称，自战事爆发以来，他一直在哈特路43号李余兴洗衣公司受雇，并居住在该处，此前他在大连路的一家洗衣店工作。

上述事实已转告“B”分区巡官贝克先生，他随后指示，在按以下理解提取指纹后，可将该被捕者移交给日本军警。

据此理解，该男子于1938年1月14日下午12时50分被移交。

Assistance to Japanese Military Police
Arrest of Six male Chinese in Far Eastern hotel

At 8.30 p.m. 13-1-38, a telephone message was received at Central Station from the Japanese Military Police requesting assistance to effect the arrest of suspects in Louza District. D.S. Kobayashi responded and at 9.40 p.m. a party of Japanese Military Police under Sergeant Major Y. Shibuya in plain clothes called at Central Station. They were escorted by D.S. Kobayashi to Louza Station where assistance was rendered by D.S. Nicoll, C.D.C. 243, C.D.C.s 177 and 341 and the party proceeded to Room 502 of the Far Eastern Hotel, 90 Yu Ya Ching Road. Six male Chinese, described below, in the room were taken into custody at 10.15 p.m.:—

(1) Yue Zung Tsai (于仁才), age 34, Ningpo, M/fitter, residing 143 Rue Palikao.
(2) Wei Hoong Cimin (魏鴻均), age 30, Hupeh, M/hong assistant, residing unnumbered house off Singapore Road, O.O.L.
(3) Sung Ying Kiang (沈英江), age 25, Kading, S/unemployed, residing Sing Tai Lodging House, 143 Rue des Peres, F.C.

(5) Tsang Foh Kung (張福根), age 20, Ningpo, S/fitter, 143 Rue des Peres, F.C.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

(6) Tsang Ah Kung (〔此处转录不清〕), age 27, Ningpo,
K/J.G.O.J.Conductor No.156, residing Sing
Tai Lodging House, 143 Rue des Peres, F.C.

A search of their persons and the room revealed
nothing of an incriminating nature.

According to Sergeant Major Shibuya, the accused
were suspected of being concerned in an outrage at Jesse-
field on 9-1-38 when a bomb exploded near an Italian
sentry. He stated that six male Chinese had already
been arrested in Western Shanghai for the same affair
and information from these had led the Japanese Mili-
tary to the above hotel room.

Brought to the Station the accused were ques-
tioned by D.S. MacAdie and it was ascertained that the
room had been engaged by the 4th named, as he stated,
for the purpose of recreation. The remaining accused
had all called there to visit the 4th accused. The
Japanese military requested that the accused be not
questioned by Chinese detectives as to their activities.

On request of the representatives of the Japanese
Military for the handing over of the six accused, Mr.
H.D.M. Robertson, D.O."A" Division, was communicated
with and he in turn consulted Mr. R.C. Alers, D.C.
Divisions, who authorized their handing over for en-
quiries.

对其人身及房间进行的搜查未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。

据涩谷军曹称，被告涉嫌参与1938年1月9日在极司菲尔路发生的一起暴行，当时一枚炸弹在意大利哨兵附近爆炸。他称，已有六名华籍男子因此事在上海西区被捕，从这些人那里获得的情报引导日本军方找到了上述酒店房间。

被告被带至巡捕房后，由侦探警长麦卡迪进行讯问，查明该房间是由第四名被告预订的，据他称，目的是娱乐。其余被告均是去拜访第四名被告。日本军方要求不得由中国侦探讯问被告的活动情况。

应日本军方代表要求移交六名被告，已与“A”分区巡官罗伯逊先生联系，他随即咨询了分区副巡官艾尔斯先生，后者授权将其移交以供查问。

The Japanese military representatives were requested through D.S. Kobayashi to return the accused to the Municipal Police when their enquiries were completed or should they fail to do so to inform the Police of the manner of disposal of the case and the charges preferred against the accused. This the representatives agreed to do.

The six accused were handed over to the Military Police at 11.30 p.m. after their finger prints had been taken. The party was escorted to the Jessfield Headquarters of the Japanese Military Police by S.I. Phillips and D.S. Kobayashi.

Three female Chinese found in the hotel were not taken into custody as the Military Police did not require them. Their descriptions are given hereunder:-

(1) Lee Zung Sz (李陳氏), age 26, Honan, wife of the 4th accused.
(2) Wei Shu Sz (魏許氏), age 26, Hangchow, wife of the 2nd accused.
(3) Wu Zung Sz (吳陳氏), age 28, Tsungning, M/female, N.F.A., friend of the 1st named female.

According to the first named female, her husband, the 4th accused, was formerly a school master employed at a school in Jessfield district. It is to be noted

已通过侦探警长小林要求日本军方代表，在其查问结束后将被告交还工部局警务处，或者若未能做到，则通知警方案件的处理方式及对被告提出的指控。代表们同意照办。

六名被告在提取指纹后，于晚上11时30分移交给军警。由印籍巡官菲利普斯和侦探警长小林护送该队前往日本军警极司菲尔路总部。

在酒店发现的三名华籍女子未被拘捕，因为军警不需要她们。她们的描述如下：-

(1) 李陈氏，26岁，河南人，第四名被告之妻。
(2) 魏许氏，26岁，杭州人，第二名被告之妻。
(3) 吴陈氏，28岁，崇明人，女/女性，非正式助理，第一名女子的朋友。

据第一名女子称，她的丈夫，即第四名被告，以前是极司菲尔区一所学校的教员。值得注意的是
